evidence.why: Complete phase machine, exact countdown assignments/decrements, per-case returns and terminal default.

facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline placement of the 120- and 30-update holds while retaining guards, immediate phases, numeric terminal behavior and conditional callback lifetime.
facts.value: Dispatches active camera phases 0–9 through fp->mv.ch.unk4.x0, with one phase executed per invocation. Phase 0 configures the opening target and starts a 120-unit camera transition. Phases 1–3 wait for Camera_8002F260; phase 1 registers fn_8015B4EC and starts a 20-unit transition, phase 2 starts a 60-unit transition, and phase 3 configures the next shot. Phase 4 captures the current camera position and sets x8=120. Phase 5 expires that 120-update hold and sets x8=30; phase 6 expires 30 and sets another 30; phase 7 expires the second 30, configures the final shot and sets 50. Phase 8 captures current camera position and advances without decrementing. Phase 9 expires the 50-update countdown, restores standard camera mode and stores 10. Countdown transitions require predecrement to equal exactly zero. Phase 10 and other unhandled values take the inert default path. Terminal handling does not clear accessory4_cb.
